name: Analysis procedures (core)
description: The starter library of analysis procedures (DS022 "Analysis procedures"): procedure bundles of rules, integrity constraints, aggregates and parameter facts that the analyzer (lib/analysis) applies to the document layer of a session or a base memory — contradictions, numeric and temporal consistency, claims without support, a sample KPI set and a sample quality rubric — together with the document-analysis vocabulary they read and the document view the analyzer writes. Domain procedures are added as data in the same form. Imports core-min.
